summary: Dragonheir's 1st Anniversary celebration introduces a three-phase web event titled Prelude to Nightfall. In Phase 1 (Sept 2–Sept 9), players log in daily to roll dice, unlocking story entries and rewards such as Scholar Scrolls and up to 1,400 Wyrmarrow. Phase 2 (Sept 9–Sept 15) allows players to claim a free Legendary hero and select their faction. Phase 3 (Sept 15–Oct 2) opens an ultimate prize pool with physical prizes and a Legendary hero option chest.
tips: Log into the interactive web event page daily during Phase 1 to roll the dice and accumulate Wyrmarrow and Scholar Scrolls.
Make sure to log in during Phase 2 (starting September 9th) to claim the free Legendary hero and participate in faction quests.
title: DON'T MISS OUT! FREE Legendary & Tons Of Rewards... Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
